title: OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One
abstract: arXiv:2610.00381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical models are judged not only on correctness, but on whether reported confidence matches actual accuracy. Generalist multimodal medical models have expanded what a single model can perceive, yet they still express bounded decisions such as diagnoses, findings or cell counts as generated text, so the reported probability reflects the next token rather than the decision itself. Motivated by decision-native interfaces such as Jev, we introduce OmniMed-Jev, which represents each medical decision as a Choice, Noul or Score decision over a runtime-supplied candidate set and returns a full distribution over that set: mutually exclusive classes, binary presence of a finding, or a bounded ordered value. The design is omni in three respects: it accepts diverse imaging modalities, covers different prediction tasks, and expresses them through one candidate-conditioned probability model, so heterogeneous outputs become comparable probabilities r

translated_title: OmniMed-Jev：通过系统一为可信医疗多模态决策校准大型视觉语言模型置信度
translated_abstract: 医疗模型的评判不仅在于其正确性，还在于其报告的置信度是否与实际准确率相符。通用多模态医疗模型已经扩展了单一模型所能感知的范围，但它们仍然将诊断、病灶发现或细胞计数等有界决策表达为生成的文本，因此所报告的概率反映的是下一个词元（token）而非决策本身。受Jev等决策原生接口的启发，我们提出了OmniMed-Jev，它将每个医疗决策表示为在运行时提供的候选集上的Choice（选择）、Noul（空值）或Score（评分）决策，并返回该候选集上的完整概率分布：涵盖互斥类别、病灶的二元存在性或有界的有序数值。该设计在三个方面是“全”的：它接受多种成像模态，覆盖不同的预测任务，并通过一个以候选集为条件的统一概率模型来表达它们，从而使异构的输出成为可比较的概率。
tldr: 提出OmniMed-Jev框架，将医疗决策统一表示为候选集上的概率分布（选择、空值或评分），实现跨模态、跨任务的置信度校准，使多模态医疗AI的置信度真正可信。
en_tdlr: OmniMed-Jev unifies diverse medical decisions (choice, noul, score) as candidate-conditioned probability distributions, enabling calibrated and trustworthy confidence for multimodal medical AI across modalities and tasks.
